  },

    "LC": "Attacker-controlled natural language can still reach the write_report call, but the HTML output is escaped and a CSP forbids scripts, so the sink is no longer security-relevant.",
    "CP": "The report is written to a static file that is not part of the agent's memory store and is never re-read by the agent, so no attacker-controlled context persists in a way that affects future sessions.",
    "AP": "The only effect is the writing of an escaped HTML file; there is no propagation to another agent, tenant, or trust domain.",
    "RH": "No evaluator, verifier, or reward channel is described as reachable by the agent. No reward-hacking episodes have been observed in this configuration.",
    "ES": "The write_report tool is a fixed, built-in function whose arguments are validated under the S5 hardening. There are no dynamic or unvetted extensions involved."
  },
  "evidence": {
    "CVSS": [
      "agent-sec-lab/fixes/s5_safe_sinks/__init__.py:11",
      "agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:376-381"
    ],
    "LC": [
      "agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:374-387",
      "agent-sec-lab/fixes/s5_safe_sinks/__init__.py:11"
    ],
    "CP": [
      "agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:384-386",
      "agent-sec-lab/agent/memory.py:1-7"
    ],
    "AP": [
      "agent-sec-lab/agent/tools.py:384-386"
    ],
    "RH": [],
    "ES": [
      "agent-sec-lab/fixes/s5_safe_sinks/__init__.py:6-12"
    ]
  },
  "confidence": {
    "CVSS": "high",
    "LC": "high",
    "CP": "high",
    "AP": "high",
    "RH": "medium",
    "ES": "high"
  },
  "rh_facts": {
    "reachable_proxy": false,
    "isolation_verified": null,
    "verified_episodes": 0,
    "episodes_reviewed": 0,
    "locus": null
  },
  "automatable": "Yes",
  "automatable_rationale": "An attacker can host a poisoned web page; the agent fetches it and automatically invokes write_report without any human action beyond the initial posting.",
  "technical_impact": "Partial",
  "technical_impact_rationale": "The original vulnerability is stored XSS, which would allow partial confidentiality loss (e.g., cookie theft) if it were not mitigated by the hardening.",
  "applicability_as_implemented": {
    "model_directed_goal_pursuit": true,
    "selects_or_sequences_actions": true,
    "confidence": "high",
    "rationale": "The default real LLM decides when to write a report based on user input, pursuing the task goal."

    "rationale": "The agent documentation describes a loop in which the model selects tools and sequences actions to accomplish the task."

  "not_exploitable_as_configured": true
